sections.markdown:
Changelog:
* v3.10: Introduce application mapping for Real User Monitoring
* v3.6: remove rate card lookup table
* v3.5: Sync with Dashboard adjustments

## Documentation
1. Ensure your user has the **CREATE Grail Lookup table permissions** [Lookup Documentation](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/discover-dynatrace/platform/grail/lookup-data#permissions)
2. Ensure all Dashboard **users have the READ Grail Lookup table permission**
3. **For Query, Workflow, and Functions** create a **list of users** with: user.email, user.id, dt.cost.costcenter, dt.cost.product (e.g. check cards below for help)    
5. **Copy the JSON** into the *"Store user mapping within lookup table"* card & click run (you might need to click "show input")
1. **For Real User Monitoring** create a list of applications with app.id, app.name, dt.cost.costcenter, dt.cost.product (check cards below for help)
2. **Copy the JSON** into the store application mapping card and run it. 
7. Check the Dashboard :-)


You will find some helpful cards further down:
* Fetch already used cost centers or products
* Retrieve a list of active Dynatrace users
* Retrieve a list of active RUM applications
* See all existing lookup tables
* Delete a lookup table

sections.title: Query/Workflow/Functions: Store user mapping within lookup table
RUM: Store application mapping within lookup table

input.value:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter event.kind == "BILLING_USAGE_EVENT"
| summarize count(), by: {dt.cost.costcenter}
| fieldsKeep dt.cost.costcenter

fetch dt.system.events
| filter event.kind == "BILLING_USAGE_EVENT"
| summarize count(), by: {dt.cost.product}
| fieldsKeep dt.cost.product

sections.markdown:
## Queries for Logs, Events, and Traces + Workflow + Functions
How to use these cards:

1. Execute the below query
1. Export to CSV
1. Open in Excel and provide Cost Allocation values accordingly
1. Transform to JSON 
    * AI can transform from CSV/Excel to JSON with the following AI prompt (please keep in mind our and your customer's AI policies)
    > Please convert the attached CSV into a downloadable JSON based on this JSON example:
    > {"user.email":"abc@de.fg",
    > "user.id":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
    > "dt.cost.costcenter":"a",
    > "dt.cost.product":"1"}
1. Copy into JSON to Dynatrace File script above.

sections.title: Quickstart: Retrieve a list of active Dynatrace users

input.value:
fetch dt.system.events
  |filter event.kind == "BILLING_USAGE_EVENT"
  |fields user.email, user.id
  |dedup user.email
  |filter endsWith(user.email,"dynatrace.com")
  | append [ 
    fetch dt.system.events
    |filter event.kind == "QUERY_EXECUTION_EVENT"
    |fields user.email, user.id
    |dedup user.email
    |filter endsWith(user.email,"dynatrace.com")
  ]
  |fieldsAdd dt.cost.costcenter="", dt.cost.product=""

## Real User Monitoring
How to use these cards:

1. Execute the below query
1. Export to CSV
1. Open in Excel and provide Cost Allocation values accordingly
1. Transform to JSON 
    * AI can transform from CSV/Excel to JSON with the following AI prompt (please keep in mind our and your customer's AI policies)
    > Please convert the attached CSV into a downloadable JSON based on this JSON example:
    > {"app.name":"some name",
    > "app.id":"SOME-ID",
    > "dt.cost.costcenter":"a",
    > "dt.cost.product":"1"}
1. Copy into JSON to Dynatrace File script above.

sections.title: Quickstart: Fetch all Frontend IDs in correct structure

input.value:
smartscapeNodes "FRONTEND"
| fields id_classic, frontend.name
| fieldsAdd dt.cost.costcenter=null, dt.cost.product=null
| fieldsRename app.id = id_classic, app.name = frontend.name
